name: Dearest Elenia,
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
She was so sad. I could see that, once I saw past her state. I mean, she seemed sad - wouldn't you?

But after talking to her, there was a connection. I didn't think anyone could understand what I was thinking, but she could.

When I told the others, they laughed at me, so I never spoke with her again. But I miss her. Can you take this letter to her for me? I want to be sure it finds her hands.
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Slightly Creased Note to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: You wouldn't expect an orc to be so eloquent. Of course, we never really had a chance to know them before now. Thank you for bringing this to me.
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, and to what do I owe this pleasure?
